desc:
Swing on the bars, let go, flip and twist through the air, then regrab! A ragdoll bar gymnastics game with real physics.

MOBILE, PC, CONSOLE, AND NEW VR SUPPORT!
Warning: VR Support is heavily WIP as of right now.

🤸 Floppy ragdoll physics: every swing, flip and landing is simulated
🔁 Regrab bars, chain combos and rack up trick scores
🗺️ Bar and tumbling maps with trampolines and moving blocks
🎯 Daily quests and an all-time regrab leaderboard
🎨 Skins, Chalk crates with shown odds and daily rewards
📱 Plays on phone, tablet and PC, with custom keybinds

PC controls: Click = Let Go / Twist, Left = Arch, Space = Tuck, E = Layout, S = Stick, X = Unstick, R = Reset, M = Menu.

For fans of ragdoll gymnastics games like NoomiClone. Not affiliated with or endorsed by NoomiClone, Noomi or their developer.
